brief: Five body shapes for the screenshot variant

slots.subtitle: Not the stack diagram anyone posts. The five things actually open on the second monitor at four in the afternoon.

slots.toolTagline: One page the whole week points at
slots.bigStatement: Everything lives in one database with three views, because four private lists is how work goes missing.
slots.useNote: Replaced a task app, a wiki and a spreadsheet

slots.toolTagline: If it is not on the board it is not happening, and nothing sits there longer than a week.
The blank page is the expensive part. A rough version in thirty seconds changes what you are willing to start.
Two people looking at the same frame settle in ten minutes what a thread would not settle in three days.
slots.useNote: Design, decks and anything that needs showing

slots.toolTagline: How the money side is wired
slots.noteTitle: Check revenue once. Then close the tab.
slots.line1: One dashboard, opened in the morning and not again.
slots.line2: Payments and invoices run themselves; the only manual step left is deciding what to charge.
slots.line3: Failed charges retry on their own, which used to be an afternoon of chasing people.

slots.body: Everything past the fifth tool earns its place by being opened, not by sounding useful when somebody asks what you run.
slots.signoff: The sixth one is always the one to go
